title: Apollo 11 Restored Moonwalk
contents: Restored 1969 TV broadcast, EVA Television Scene 7: Buzz Aldrin demonstrates walking, hopping and running in lunar gravity next to the flag and the Lunar Module. Black-and-white, 4:3 pillarboxed in 1280x720. Cut avoids the NASA/Apollo 40th title cards.
